stemMd: A librarian observes: Requests for a book increased after we moved it to the entrance display. This does not show that readers suddenly developed a new interest; the display may simply have made an existing interest easier to act on. Which alternative explanation is proposed?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Greater visibility converted existing interest into borrowing requests.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Every reader had already read the book.

explanationMd: The librarian distinguishes creating interest from making an existing preference actionable. Visibility can increase observed demand without a change in underlying preferences.

distractorRationale.d: Requests increased, and closure is not suggested.
distractorRationale.c: Existing interest does not imply prior reading.
distractorRationale.e: The proposed mechanism is increased accessibility.
